parameters.name: IncludeCrossAccountVbr
parameters.description:
Specifies whether cross-account VBRs are included.

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the VBR is deployed. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID.

For more information about resource groups, see [What is a resource group?](~~94475~~)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-virtual-border-routers --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --filter '[{"Value":["Active"],"Key":"Status"}]' --include-cross-account-vbr false --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph6aiy0000 --tags Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc DescribeVirtualBorderRouters --region cn-hangzhou --IncludeCrossAccountVbr false --Tags.1.Value FinanceJoshua --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxazb4ph6aiy0000' --PageNumber 1 --Filter.1.Value.1 Active --Tags.1.Key FinanceDept --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Key Status
